text: What seat count did Gideon land on for Vantorre Group in the July thread in #strategic-pod? He corrected himself in that thread and I want the corrected figure for the QBR deck.
reply_text: The corrected figure is 280 seats. Gideon first posted 300 in #strategic-pod on Jul 1 at 09:14, then corrected it to 280 at 09:19. He said the 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout, and 280 is the active production roster as of Jul 1. Nothing later in the thread changes it. I replied to you in our DM.
